nodes.name: Design — SCRUM-97 P3 Contract-First Split
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Design — SCRUM-97 P3 Contract-First Split" (specification, 5 lines): P3 compiles from desired/safe-failure outcomes backward through capabilities and evidence dependencies. NetworkX-style DiGraph semantics map to predecessors, successors, topological ordering, cycle detection and bounded path enumeration. Cytoscape.js binding uses element JSON with nodes and edges

nodes.name: Requirements — SCRUM-97 P3 Backward Graph Compiler & Scenario Decision Engine
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Requirements — SCRUM-97 P3 Backward Graph Compiler & Scenario Decision Engine" (specification, 8 lines): - Thread A / SCRUM-111: compiler request/result, backward derivation, dependency closure, deterministic ordering and planning evidence. - Thread B / SCRUM-112: scenario taxonomy, typed guards, route classification/ranking, authority stops and dominance pruning.
